intro_zh: 柴火藤蔓可以被种植在其他植物上，使本格的植物免受寒冻，对短距离内的敌人造成灼烧伤害。

learning_sentences.en: Warms plants and shoots flames
learning_sentences.zh: 温暖植物并喷出火焰

chat_en: Pyre Vine considers his holdings, his fortune, his vast hoard of wealth. He feels it should please him, and yet nevertheless he is anxious and fearful.
chat_zh: 柴火藤蔓审视着他的地产、财富和庞大的宝库。他觉得这些理应让自己满足，然而他依然感到焦虑和恐惧。

sentence: Increases sun production
sentence_zh: 促进阳光的生产
description: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last second defense when attacked.
plant_food: Produces sun and stuns all nearby zombies.
description_zh: 闪耀藤蔓能促进其依附的阳光植物的生产，使它们在生产时产出更多的阳光，月光花除外。在受到威胁的时候用阳光闪晕身边的僵尸作为防御。
intro_en: Shine Vines are vine plants that amplify the sun production of sun producer plants, except Moonflower, create some sun on their own, and use a sun-stun burst as a last second defense when attacked.
intro_zh: 闪耀藤蔓能促进其依附的阳光植物的生产，使它们在生产时产出更多的阳光，月光花除外。在受到威胁的时候用阳光闪晕身边的僵尸作为防御。

learning_sentences.en: Increases sun production
learning_sentences.zh: 促进阳光的生产

DESCRIPTION.en: best used on sun producer plants
DESCRIPTION.zh: 最好种植在生产植物上
不会促进月光花的生产

chat_en: "Peek-a-boo!" giggles Shine Vine, staring directly at you, the player. "Consider that fourth wall SHATTERED!"
chat_zh: “躲猫猫！” 闪耀藤蔓咯咯笑着，直勾勾地盯着屏幕前的你。“就当这第四面墙已经碎了吧！”

sentence: Explodes and scatters seeds
sentence_zh: 爆炸并散出种子
description: Atomic Bombegranate is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
description_zh: 原子石榴弹是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。
intro_en: Atomic Bombegranate is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
intro_zh: 原子石榴弹是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。

learning_sentences.en: Explodes and scatters seeds
learning_sentences.zh: 爆炸并散出种子

sentence: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
sentence_zh: 伤害身边的僵尸，点击发射障碍
description: Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
description_zh: 冬青骑士对身边的僵尸造成伤害，还能发射三株带刺的障碍来击退并伤害僵尸。
intro_en: Holly Knight deals damage to zombies attacking him, and can launch 3 prickly barrier leaves to knock back and damage zombies.
intro_zh: 冬青骑士对身边的僵尸造成伤害，还能发射三株带刺的障碍来击退并伤害僵尸。

learning_sentences.en: Damages attacking zombies, tap to launch barriers
learning_sentences.zh: 伤害身边的僵尸，点击发射障碍

DESCRIPTION.en: tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
DESCRIPTION.zh: 点击瞄准，再点击目标格子发射

DESCRIPTION.en: projectiles become prickly barriers when hitting the floor
DESCRIPTION.zh: 子弹砸中地面时生成带刺的障碍

chat_en: Holly Knight would like to advise folks not to eat his berries. "It's rude to eat somebody's berries without asking," he says. "In addition, they are highly toxic."
chat_zh: 冬青骑士会告诫大伙不要吃他身上的莓果。“不提前打声招呼就吃别人身上的莓果是很无礼的，”他说。“另外，他们是剧毒的。”

sentence: Creates a holly barrier
sentence_zh: 制造冬青屏障
description: Holly Barrier Leaf is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
description_zh: 冬青骑士障碍是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。
intro_en: Holly Barrier Leaf is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
intro_zh: 冬青骑士障碍是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。

learning_sentences.en: Creates a holly barrier
learning_sentences.zh: 制造冬青屏障

sentence: Creates a stronger holly barrier
sentence_zh: 制造更强的冬青屏障
description: Plantfood Holly Barrier Leaf is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
description_zh: 叶绿素冬青骑士障碍是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。
intro_en: Plantfood Holly Barrier Leaf is a helpful plant that fights zombies.
intro_zh: 叶绿素冬青骑士障碍是一种帮助你对抗僵尸的植物。

learning_sentences.en: Creates a stronger holly barrier
learning_sentences.zh: 制造更强的冬青屏障

sentence: Heals rightward plants
sentence_zh: 治疗右边的植物
description: Aloes heal injured plants to their immediate right, keeping them healthy as possible.
plant_food: Instantly heal every plant in the surrounding radius.
description_zh: 芦荟对其右边的植物进行治疗，使之尽可能保持完好。
intro_en: Aloes heal injured plants to their immediate right, keeping them healthy as possible.
intro_zh: 芦荟对其右边的植物进行治疗，使之尽可能保持完好。

learning_sentences.en: Heals rightward plants
learning_sentences.zh: 治疗右边的植物

chat_en: Aloe likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.
chat_zh: 芦荟喜欢安抚。他喜欢缓解痛苦，乐于修复创伤，擅长弥合伤痕。但别让他去复活生命——他对“复活”这个词格外敏感。

sentence: Hypnotizes electrocute zombies
sentence_zh: 魅惑随机的僵尸
description: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
plant_food: Tosses 5 random zombies off the lawn.
description_zh: 超能花菜利用他们的心灵控制能力来魅惑随机的僵尸，使之以他们的同类为敌。
intro_en: Caulipowers use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.
intro_zh: 超能花菜利用他们的心灵控制能力来魅惑随机的僵尸，使之以他们的同类为敌。

learning_sentences.en: Hypnotizes electrocute zombies
learning_sentences.zh: 魅惑随机的僵尸

chat_en: Caulipower's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
chat_zh: 超能花菜压力很大，双眼晕眩地转了起来。他只是想为自己的小说写个大结局，但是他很担心自己的表弟读不懂。

sentence: Creates gum barriers
sentence_zh: 制造口香糖障碍
description: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
plant_food: Shoots a large gum bubble that immobilizes a large number of zombies.
description_zh: 香果胶向僵尸喷溅口香糖，把他们定在原地，并拦住其身后的僵尸。
intro_en: Gumnuts pop sticky gum onto zombies, pinning them in place and causing them to block other zombies behind them.
intro_zh: 香果胶向僵尸喷溅口香糖，把他们定在原地，并拦住其身后的僵尸。

learning_sentences.en: Creates gum barriers
learning_sentences.zh: 制造口香糖障碍

DESCRIPTION.zh: 口香糖的强度与僵尸的强度有关

DESCRIPTION.en: best used against Gargantuars & Football Mechs
DESCRIPTION.zh: 最好用于巨尸和机甲橄榄

chat_en: "I only chew ham-flavored gum," exudes Gumnut. "Ham and salt."
chat_zh: “我只嚼火腿口味的口香糖，” 香果胶自信地说着，“必须是火腿加盐味的。”

sentence: Boosts defence plants
sentence_zh: 强化防御植物
description: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 防御薄荷将所有僵尸击退，并为草坪上所有防御家族植物带来强化效果。
intro_en: Reinforce-mints push all zombies back and provide a temporary boost to all Reinforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 防御薄荷将所有僵尸击退，并为草坪上所有防御家族植物带来强化效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts defence plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化防御植物

chat_en: Reinforce-mint isn't scowling. He's just workshopping defense strategies, doing what he can to support the team. Maybe he's scowling just a little bit. Fine.
chat_zh: 防御薄荷没有皱着眉头，他只是在反复推敲防御策略，尽其所能支援团队。好吧，也许……他确实皱了一点点眉头。行吧。

sentence: Boosts sun plants
sentence_zh: 强化阳光植物
description: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 启明薄荷在种植时产生一沓阳光，并为启明家族植物带来额外的能量。
intro_en: Enlighten-mints give a burst of sun when planted, and provide an additional temporary boost to Enlighten-mint Family plants.
intro_zh: 启明薄荷在种植时产生一沓阳光，并为启明家族植物带来额外的能量。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts sun plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化阳光植物

chat_en: Enlighten-mint wants to stress that while "enlightenment" is properly understood as "full comprehension of a situation," she herself frequently likes to ask follow-up questions just to be sure.
chat_zh: 启明薄荷想强调，虽然“启明”的正确理解是“对处境的完全领悟”，但她本人经常喜欢多问几个后续问题，只为图个安心。

sentence: Boosts cold plants
sentence_zh: 强化寒冻植物
description: Winter-mints chill all zombies on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 寒冻薄荷在种植时使全场僵尸进入冷冻状态，并为所有寒冻家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Winter-mints chill all zombies on the board when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Winter-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 寒冻薄荷在种植时使全场僵尸进入冷冻状态，并为所有寒冻家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts cold plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化寒冻植物

chat_en: Winter-mint has advanced degrees in cryonics and cryogenics, is a master builder of snowmen, and subscribes to season passes at three different ski resorts. He does think it's a little chilly in here, though.
chat_zh: 寒冻薄荷拥有低温学和人体冷冻学的高级学位，是堆雪人的大师，还订阅了三家不同滑雪场的季票。不过，他确实觉得那儿有点冷飕飕的。

sentence: Boosts piercing plants
sentence_zh: 强化穿刺植物
description: Spear-mints generate a column of saws from the house and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 穿刺薄荷在种植时从草坪左侧产生一列锋利的圆锯，并为所有穿刺家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Spear-mints generate a column of saws from the house and provide a temporary boost to all Spear-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 穿刺薄荷在种植时从草坪左侧产生一列锋利的圆锯，并为所有穿刺家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts piercing plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化穿刺植物

chat_en: "Slash!" Spear-mint enthuses. "Slishy-slashy-slice!" she adds, wanting to make sure she's getting her point across. She wants to be very clear on this.
chat_zh: “斩！” 穿刺薄荷激昂道。“唰唰嚓嚓——切！”她补充道，为了确保自己的意思传达到位，并且表达得极其明确。

sentence: Boosts straight shooters
sentence_zh: 强化直射子弹的植物
description: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 平射薄荷在种植时发射一打能分裂的巨型豌豆，并为所有平射家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Appease-mints fire a volley of huge peas that break into smaller peas and provide a temporary boost to all Appease-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 平射薄荷在种植时发射一打能分裂的巨型豌豆，并为所有平射家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts straight shooters
learning_sentences.zh: 强化直射子弹的植物

chat_en: Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"
chat_zh: 平射薄荷对于自己可能在争斗中退缩的说法感到极为愤慨。“没错，我叫“平射薄荷”，但这是因为我希望大家能平稳地射出子弹，而不是不愿坚持我的信念。立刻收回你那恶毒的诽谤，否则我就写一封言辞激烈的谴责信！”

sentence: Boosts melee plants
sentence_zh: 强化近战的植物
description: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 健壮薄荷在种植时缩小场上的好几个僵尸，并为所有健壮家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Enforce-mints shrink a number of zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Enforce-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 健壮薄荷在种植时缩小场上的好几个僵尸，并为所有健壮家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts melee plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化近战的植物

chat_en: Enforce-mint shrinks zombies, which may seem a bit off-brand for a guy who's all about melee damage. Enforce-mint shrugs. "I don't set policy。" he says.
chat_zh: 健壮薄荷能缩小僵尸，这对一个专精近战伤害的家伙来说似乎有点“人设不符”。健壮薄荷耸了耸肩。对此他表示：“规则不是我定的。”

sentence: Boosts fire plants
sentence_zh: 强化火焰植物
description: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 热辣薄荷在种植时在全场燃起火焰，并为所有热辣家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 热辣薄荷在种植时在全场燃起火焰，并为所有热辣家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts fire plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化火焰植物

chat_en: Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself.
chat_zh: 热辣薄荷喜欢热，他对火焰来者不拒，对烈火情有独钟，是个不折不扣的氧化与点燃狂人。要是看见你在搓两根木棍，他准会凑过来问个究竟——他实在忍不住。

sentence: Boosts explosive plants
sentence_zh: 强化爆炸植物
description: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 爆裂薄荷在种植时在场上引起几发爆炸，并为所有爆裂家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Bombard-mints set off a number of explosions on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 爆裂薄荷在种植时在场上引起几发爆炸，并为所有爆裂家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts explosive plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化爆炸植物

chat_en: "Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
chat_zh: “爆炸可好玩了，” 爆裂薄荷眼中闪着淘气的光芒说。“在消灭僵尸的时候，一连串的爆破不仅能清掉大半个场子，事后还会留下美妙的香气。那闻起来就像是……胜利的味道。”

sentence: Boosts shadow plants
sentence_zh: 强化暗影植物
description: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 暗影薄荷在种植时将场上的几只僵尸拽入地下，并为所有暗影家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
intro_zh: 暗影薄荷在种植时将场上的几只僵尸拽入地下，并为所有暗影家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts shadow plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化暗影植物

chat_en: Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
chat_zh: 暗影薄荷像忍者一样，悄无声息地从队伍里溜走了。“暗影薄荷去哪了？”其他植物问道。他们不知道，谁也不知道，暗影薄荷就是这般神出鬼没。

sentence: Boosts poison plants and fungi
sentence_zh: 强化毒性植物和菌类
description: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 剧毒薄荷在种植时使所有僵尸沾上毒液，并为所有剧毒家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 剧毒薄荷在种植时使所有僵尸沾上毒液，并为所有剧毒家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts poison plants and fungi
learning_sentences.zh: 强化毒性植物和菌类

chat_en: Ail-mint is quick to state that poison should not be taken internally. Or externally, for that matter. Really, just leave it alone. It's poison!
chat_zh: 剧毒薄荷紧急声明：毒药不可内服。同理，也不可外用。真的，碰都别碰。那可是毒药！

sentence: Boosts magical plants
sentence_zh: 强化魔法植物
description: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 魔法薄荷在种植时魅惑场上的几只僵尸，并为所有魔法家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Enchant-mints randomly hypnotize a number of zombies and provide a temporary boost to all Enchant-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 魔法薄荷在种植时魅惑场上的几只僵尸，并为所有魔法家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts magical plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化魔法植物

chat_en: "I just love musical theater。" says Enchant-mint. Yeah, it doesn't have much to do with magic or his abilities or strategic strengths, but it's a fact. He just likes the songs.
chat_zh: “我就是热爱音乐剧。” 魔法薄荷说道。没错，这和他的魔法、能力或战略优势没什么关系，但这是事实。他就是喜欢那些歌曲。

sentence: Boosts electricity plants
sentence_zh: 强化带电植物
description: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.
plant_food: No Plant Food effect.
description_zh: 电能薄荷在种植时电击全场的敌人，并为所有电能家族植物带来增益效果。
intro_en: Fila-mints do electric damage and provide a temporary boost to all Fila-mint Family plants on the lawn.
intro_zh: 电能薄荷在种植时电击全场的敌人，并为所有电能家族植物带来增益效果。

learning_sentences.en: Boosts electricity plants
learning_sentences.zh: 强化带电植物

chat_en: Fila-mint hovers enigmatically and electrically over the lawn, surveying his surroundings. He nods, once. It is good.
chat_zh: 电能薄荷神奇地、带电地悬浮在草坪上空，审视着四周。他点了下头，一下，情况不错。
